description: Deye and Sunsynk single-phase storage (hybrid) inverter over Modbus RTU: identity, grid, inverter, load, battery and PV measurements, energy counters, battery and time-of-use settings, lithium battery data and meter values
source: Deye, Modbus RTU Protocol (single-phase storage inverters), file V118
notes: Modbus RTU on RS-485 (the manual also names RS-232), 9600 baud; the manual gives no parity or stop bits, so 8N1 is assumed. Function 03 reads (1 to 125 registers) and function 16 (0x10) writes (1 to 123 registers); the station address is in register 1, range 1 to 247.
Addresses are the decimal register numbers of the manual; address base 0. Reserved registers return 0.

The manual states 32-bit values as a low word and a high word at consecutive registers, so word order is little (low word first). Two totals (grid buy at 78 and 80, generator at 92 and 95) have their words apart and are mapped as two 16-bit registers.

The manual has one table for micro-inverters, string inverters and storage inverters, with separate String and Hybrid rows for registers 59 to 99. Only the hybrid (storage) rows are mapped here, plus the storage-only blocks 150 to 196 and 200 to 330. The string-inverter block 150 to 197 and the registers 198 to 218 (which overlap the storage settings) are left out.

Temperatures are sent as the temperature plus 100.0 degrees in tenths (0 degrees is 1000, 20.0 degrees is 1200), so scale 0.1 with offset -100. The power factor register 39 is sent as the power factor plus 1.000.

Parallel-system registers, California grid-code registers, calibration, battery pack identity (500 and up) and the alarm bit tables are not mapped. Registers 22 to 24 and 421 to 423 hold the time as byte pairs (year since 2000, month, day, hour, minute, second).

Sunsynk inverters of the single-phase range use the same protocol, Sunsynk having no document of its own; the document used is Deye's, whose version history ends at V117 and whose file name reads V118.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
